retiredScripts.rationale: The formal streamlining review proved that cached ESLint covers the same 793 JavaScript and module files as the legacy per-file node --check subprocess fan-out, so keeping both syntax parsers in the full release gate duplicated coverage and cost.
retiredScripts.assertionDisposition: JavaScript and module parsing plus lint failures are owned by the cached ESLint stage in npm run check, which now runs before the stateful regression suite. The retained fast-check pipeline release gate proves the ESLint source roots, fail-fast order, and removal from the frozen legacy snapshot.
